page: Amazon Web Services mac2-m2pro.metal is a dedicated bare-metal server utilizing Apple silicon based on the arm64_mac architecture. It delivers 12 physical cores and 12 dedicated vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.5 GHz, with one thread per core and no hypervisor virtualization layer. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of memory, yielding 2.67 GB of RAM per core.

The hardware configuration includes no onboard local storage, meaning all operational data, operating system images, and repository checkouts require network-attached storage volumes. Network capabilities include a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating typical code transfer and repository synchronization demands, while offering zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance does not include discrete GPU accelerators.

By delivering raw bare-metal hardware access without virtualization penalties, the server provides full, consistent utilization of its 12 Apple cores. The memory-to-core ratio of 2.67 GB represents a compute-focused distribution. These hardware attributes make mac2-m2pro.metal suited for Apple ecosystem development, including macOS and iOS continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines, automated testing, and native software compilation.
